about.subtitle: Software Engineer · AI-Native · Cybersecurity
about.profileDescription: Full-Stack Software Engineer and Systems Engineer with a Master’s in Communication Networks and 15+ years building web, mobile and AI-native solutions for banking, government, telecom and real estate. Founder of hackeruna.com and creator of Pulsai. Author of the book "Programar con IA, Programar para la IA".

webDev.title: Full-Stack Web
webDev.description: Angular, React, Vue.js on the frontend; Symfony, Laravel and API Platform on the backend. Scalable architectures, SPA, PWA and REST APIs for banking and government.

blockchain.title: Blockchain & Web3
blockchain.description: Solidity smart contracts on Ethereum, dApps and Zero-Knowledge Proofs with Noir for verifiable privacy.

zkProofs.title: ZK-Proofs
zkProofs.description: Implementation of Zero-Knowledge Proofs for privacy and scalability. Knowledge in zkSNARKs, zkSTARKs and consensus protocols.

ai.title: AI-Native & MCP
